queries.query: Sillanpaa Journal of Radiotherapy in Practice 2025 RT-Mind_AI Autocontour Annotate head and neck geometric dosimetric comparison

findings.observation: Confirmed real, vendor-independent, external comparative paper not currently in the product's evidence or keyPapers arrays: Sillanpaa JK, Sood AJ, Reynolds M, 'A geometric and dosimetric comparison of three AI-based autocontouring packages in the head and neck region,' J Radiother Pract 2025, doi:10.1017/S1460396925100204 (University of Minnesota). The paper explicitly names and tests 'RT-Mind_AI 1.0 (MM)' head-to-head against Radformation AutoContour and TheraPanacea Annotate on 13 CT sets/14 OARs, reporting RT-Mind slightly underperforming the other two on geometric metrics (50.0% of OARs with Dice>0.7 vs 57.1%/64.3%) and receiving mixed physician accuracy/acceptability scores. This is the first fully vendor-independent, non-MedMind-co-authored comparative evidence for this product; all four papers currently in the record have MedMind co-authors (vendorIndependent:false throughout).
findings.suggestedFix: Add this DOI to keyPapers/evidence as a vendor-independent comparative study (balanced result: RT-Mind performed somewhat worse than two peer products on the tested cohort); consider whether evidenceVendorIndependent should move from false toward 'mixed' given this independent paper now exists alongside the vendor-affiliated set.
